svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Wireframe: the site’s home page
svg.desc: The order of the home page: the Alpha line a visitor reads, the hero with its drawing and the six Leaving names under its buttons, three facts, three steps, where to, the sections that stay, one price line with its buttons, and the footer.
svg.text: Ownpace is in its Alpha, by invitation. Nothing is charged during the Alpha. Request access
T1 (a): the visitor’s line (open question 5), the app’s own words copied into copy.mjs and guarded; the site’s muted style, not a banner
Ownpace copies your mail, contacts, calendar and files to a European
provider you choose — and keeps the copy in step until you decide to
switch over. No weekend deadline. No big-bang cutover. Your old
account stays exactly where it is until you say otherwise.
Free: one migration at a time, up to 250 GB. Every price is published in full.
T5 (b): each name opens its Leaving… page; the list is the app’s own (D4, D7)
T3 (a): hero-move.svg, inlined; on a phone it sits below the buttons
Nothing is deleted at the source.
Your old account stays whole: it is your way back.
Kept in step until you switch.
New mail and changed files keep arriving.
A list of what arrived, item by item.
And what could not come, with the reason.
T3 (a) and T8: three facts under the hero; none says "read-only" (0144 T3); each links the guard that holds it
Connect the account you are leaving
Your old account stays as it is.
Every change arrives in your new home.
Check what arrived first. No deadline.
The whole of How it works →
T3 (b): the five steps folded into three, in build.mjs’s .step style, linking the full page
Your new home is an account you open with a European provider, paid to them. Ownpace moves your data into it and keeps it in step.
T4: a guarded copy of the app’s target list; data types only, never their prices, hosting or quality
What makes this different · What it will not do: these sections stay, in their places, with their words

text.tspan: , for one person moving everything at once:
€2.50 a month, paid as €30 a year

svg.text: Four migrations at the same time and 750 GB of data moved. All prices include VAT.
T1 (b): a fact about the tier, not "Most people"; T6 (c): the calculator’s button; T6 (e): the year’s total beside the per-month figure
Ownpace — move your own data, at your own pace. Open source under the Apache License 2.0.
